decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 168 instructions, 672-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xf4e9d97c.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage after recording the required compatibility defines and exclusions.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN contract passed 2/2 cases in both reproducible cycles, covering formatting, offsets, cursor handling and callback ABI.
review_findings: Joern retains one high-severity userspace-egress finding; this is a review obligation, not a reconstruction mismatch.
